# Psalm 14 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For-the-choirmaster. Of-David. The-fool says in-his-heart, 'There-is-no God.' They-are-corrupt; they-make-abominable [their] deeds; there-is-no-one doing good.

**2** YHWH from-heaven looks-down upon the-sons of-man, to-see if-there-is [one who] understands, [one who] seeks God.

**3** All have-turned-aside; together they-are-corrupt; there-is-no-one doing good — not even one.

**4** Do-they-not know, all workers-of iniquity, who-eat my-people [as] they-eat bread? YHWH they-do-not call-upon.

**5** There they-are-in-great-dread, for God [is] with-the-righteous generation.

**6** The-counsel of-the-afflicted you-would-put-to-shame, but YHWH [is] his-refuge.

**7** Oh-that from-Zion [would come] the-salvation of-Israel! When-YHWH restores the-fortunes of-His-people, Jacob will-rejoice; Israel will-be-glad.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **14:1**: 'Fool' (naval) is not intellectual deficiency but moral bankruptcy — the same word describing Nabal in 1 Samuel 25.

— EMET
